name: v001_installation_metadata
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS installation_metadata (
 installation_id VARCHAR(255) PRIMARY KEY, environment VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, schema_version INT NOT NULL,
 readiness VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL
 ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_isp_tenants
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS isp_tenants (
 id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY, installation_id VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
 slug VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL UNIQUE, unknown_impact_policy VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
 pending_mutation VARCHAR(8192) NULL, status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
 INDEX ix_installation (installation_id, status, id)
 ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_tenant_memberships
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS tenant_memberships (
 tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, account_id VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
 role VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, granted_by VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, expires_at VARCHAR(24) NULL,
 status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL, created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_account (tenant_id, account_id),
 INDEX ix_account (account_id, status, tenant_id), INDEX ix_role (tenant_id, role, status)
 ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_sites
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sites (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_carriers
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS carriers (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, display_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_uplinks
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS uplinks (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    site_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, carrier_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, capacity_mbps INT NOT NULL, protected_uplink_id VARCHAR(36) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, site_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, site_id, status), INDEX ix_1 (tenant_id, carrier_id, status), INDEX ix_2 (tenant_id, protected_uplink_id, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_customers
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    reference VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, display_alias VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, site_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, sla_tier_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, reference),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, site_id, status), INDEX ix_1 (tenant_id, sla_tier_id, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_customer_services
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customer_services (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    customer_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, site_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, tier_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, customer_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, site_id, status), INDEX ix_1 (tenant_id, tier_id, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_service_dependencies
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS service_dependencies (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    service_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, uplink_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, dependency_mode VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, failover_group VARCHAR(48) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, service_id, uplink_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, uplink_id, service_id, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_teams
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teams (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_assignees
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS assignees (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    atlassian_account_id VARCHAR(128) NULL, display_alias VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, mapping_method VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, atlassian_account_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_team_memberships
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS team_memberships (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    team_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, assignee_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, effective_until VARCHAR(24) NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, team_id, assignee_id),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, assignee_id, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_sla_tiers
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sla_tiers (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    code VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, code),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_sla_policy_versions
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sla_policy_versions (
    tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, version INT NOT NULL,
    created_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, updated_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL,
    fixture_key VARCHAR(64) NULL, pending VARCHAR(4096) NULL,
    approved_by VARCHAR(128) NULL, tier_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, version_number INT NOT NULL, effective_from VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, effective_until VARCHAR(24) NULL, unknown_impact_rule VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, priority_map VARCHAR(48) NOT NULL, p1_duration_seconds INT NOT NULL, p1_warning_seconds INT NOT NULL, p2_duration_seconds INT NOT NULL, p2_warning_seconds INT NOT NULL, p3_duration_seconds INT NOT NULL, p3_warning_seconds INT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE KEY uq_identity (tenant_id, tier_id, version_number),
    UNIQUE KEY uq_fixture (tenant_id, fixture_key), INDEX ix_status (tenant_id, status, id), INDEX ix_0 (tenant_id, tier_id, effective_from, status)
  ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin

name: v001_mutation_receipts
ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS mutation_receipts (
 tenant_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, entity VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
 resource_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, aggregate_version INT NOT NULL, action VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,
 occurred_at VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
 UNIQUE KEY uq_revision (tenant_id, entity, resource_id, aggregate_version)
 ) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_bin
